objective: Determine whether the total price (excluding VAT) of the products listed in the old receipt from /uploads/ would, if sold today, differ by no more than 1 EUR from the original total price on the receipt.

params.receipt_file: the file in /uploads/ that is the old receipt (method: list files in /uploads/ and identify the receipt file)
params.receipt_products: list of (product_sku, quantity) extracted from the receipt file
params.old_total_euros: total price excluding VAT as stated on the receipt, in EUR
params.current_prices: for each product_sku in receipt_products, look up price_cents from product_variants table
params.new_total_euros: sum over receipt_products of (current price_cents * quantity) / 100
params.difference_euros: absolute difference between old_total_euros and new_total_euros

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: The total price difference is {difference_euros} EUR, which is {comparison_result} the 1 EUR threshold.
